## About
APMC Direct is an online wholesale marketplace operated by an authorised APMC (Agricultural Produce Market Committee) Vashi, Navi Mumbai agent. The platform sells fresh fruits, dry fruits and spices at today's regulated mandi rates to B2B buyers — hotels, fruit shops, juice centres, restaurants, sweet marts, caterers and institutional buyers — across Maharashtra, with transporter-tracked doorstep delivery.

The platform runs a four-party coordination model:
1. Owner (Admin) — sets pricing, manages the website and client onboarding.
2. Buyer (APMC Yard) — aggregates orders and negotiates at the APMC Vashi yard.
3. Transporter — contracted logistics partner operating from an internal rate card.
4. Client — the hotel, fruit shop, juice centre, restaurant, sweet mart or caterer who receives goods at the doorstep and pays online or cash-on-delivery.

Key strength: precise four-party coordination that ensures correct goods, correct price and correct delivery on every transaction.

## What we sell
Fresh fruits, dry fruits and spices sourced at APMC Market, Sector 19, Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra. Indicative categories:

- Fresh fruits — Banana (Elaichi / Robusta), Apple, Pomegranate, Mosambi, Orange, Papaya, Watermelon, Pineapple, Kiwi, Dragon Fruit, Tender Coconut, Mango, Grapes, Lemon.
- Dry fruits — Almonds, Cashews, Raisins, Pistachios, Walnuts, Figs, Dates, Kishmish.
- Spices & masala — Turmeric, Red Chilli, Coriander, Cumin, Black Pepper, Green Cardamom, Cloves, Cinnamon, Fennel, Mustard.

## How to order
1. Open the order portal: https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzHd5gv6pkhuxJ5mgoTUK8OQeQfys2_lVT67cV75O09PkUXErHRa19NJL4BuyfSHKsPww/exec
2. Sign in with your business contact details.
3. Browse the live rate list (refreshed at APMC yard opening each morning).
4. Add items, confirm delivery address, pay online (UPI / bank / cash).
5. Receive SMS / WhatsApp confirmation with transporter dispatch details.

## Delivery geography
Same-day: Navi Mumbai, Mumbai, Thane, Mira-Bhayandar.
Next-day: Pune, Nashik, other key Maharashtra cities.
Custom bulk slots for hotel chains.

## Minimum order
₹2,000 minimum basket for MMR; ₹5,000 minimum for out-of-MMR deliveries. Bulk hotel contracts available.

## Who can buy
B2B only — verified hotels, fruit shops, juice centres, restaurants, sweet marts, caterers and institutional buyers. Not a retail consumer channel.
